title: Playboy Magazine July 1973 Kurt Vonnegut Interview Bobby Fischer Roger Moore
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows overall toning, soiling and edge wear, with corner wear and light creasing. The back cover has soiling and staining along the edges, shown in the photos. Spine intact. No mailing label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, July 1973 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- The Playboy Interview with Kurt Vonnegut, Jr. - one of the most widely reprinted interviews he ever gave, from the period just after "Slaughterhouse-Five" made him famous
- Bobby Fischer - You Don't Know the Half of Him, published the year after his world championship match with Spassky
- Bond Gets Sainted! Roger Moore as 007 in "Live and Let Die" - coverage of Moore's first Bond film, released that same summer
- One Last Crack at Glorious Decadence: Joseph Wechsberg aboard the France
- Eight Freaky Ways to Beat the Stock Market
- On Location with J.C. and All the Gang: Jesus Christ Superham

Zipper cover design.

The back cover carries a 1973 Dewar's "White Label" Profiles ad featuring physicist Sheila Ann T. Long.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
